COD.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.
The only AI system described is the exam-grading tool of the education ministry, a sector system.

facts.fact: MINEDU-NC reports the education ministry's locally developed automated, AI-based correction of State Examination papers was demonstrated at CASP 2025 in Kinshasa on 17 December 2025, with inspectors keeping the decision role.
MINEDU-NC says the new AI correction solution processes 80 to 100 copies a minute, against 8 to 10 for the old system.

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship

facts.fact: MINEDU-NC describes the AI exam-correction innovation shown at CASP 2025 as developed locally.

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship
